title: desktop-control-verify: cached-element control of Windows desktop applications, drawing-to-specification extraction and code-enforced build verification
description:
General-purpose layers extracted, with their development history, from a private system that automates design entry in a Windows cabinet-design application that has no automation interface. The control layer discovers the application's UI Automation tree once and then drives it through cached, window-relative element positions. The verification layer compares a vision-model extraction of a drawing with independent readings of the drawing and of the built result, and decides PASS or FAIL in code.

Underlying development took place privately between 25 January and 5 March 2026. The repository was extracted on 25 September 2026 and first released publicly on 28 September 2026. Development was AI-assisted; see the README's AI-assistance section.
